description: This file defines API routes for managing 'notes' in a backend service using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting notes, with filtering options for search and archived status.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: list_notes( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query to filter notes by title"), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by archived status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists notes with optional search and filtering for archived status.

methods.name: get_note(note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by UUID.

methods.name: create_note(payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided title, content, and optional tags and archived status.

methods.name: update_note(note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by UUID with provided fields.

methods.name: delete_note(note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by UUID.

ctags.name: list_notes
ctags.signature: ( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query to filter notes by title"), archived: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Filter by archived status"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
ctags.signature: (note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
